concept.title: Review, Stage, Commit, and Synchronize Changes

conbody.p: Use this section for the main daily Git workflow in the Git Staging view. Review the changed resources in the Unstaged files area, compare changes when needed, move the files that belong in the next commit to the Staged files area, commit the staged files, and then push or pull changes as needed. If a pull operation reports conflicts, resolve them before you continue.
